expected_scenes.title: The Problem
expected_scenes.narration: You're drowning in tabs. Drowning in notifications. Drowning in noise.
expected_scenes.visualDescription: A frustrated office worker staring at a cluttered desktop screen filled with dozens of open browser tabs, spreadsheets, and notifications, harsh fluorescent lighting, papers scattered on the desk, coffee cup half-empty
expected_scenes.musicDescription: Tense, minimal electronic pulse, low synth drone with irregular glitchy ticks
expected_scenes.sfxDescription: Keyboard clacking, notification pings overlapping, mouse clicks

expected_scenes.title: The Breaking Point
expected_scenes.narration: There has to be a better way.
expected_scenes.visualDescription: An office worker slamming their laptop shut in frustration, the screen going dark, a moment of silence and darkness
expected_scenes.musicDescription: Music cuts to silence on the slam, then a single sustained note

expected_scenes.title: FocusFlow Introduction
expected_scenes.narration: Introducing FocusFlow. One workspace. Zero chaos.
expected_scenes.visualDescription: Clean minimal workspace with a single monitor displaying the FocusFlow app interface, soft natural light from a window, a small plant on the desk, worker looking relaxed and in control
expected_scenes.musicDescription: Bright, optimistic synth melody, clean and modern
expected_scenes.sfxDescription: Soft UI chime as the app appears on screen

expected_scenes.title: Smart Tabs
expected_scenes.narration: Smart Tabs learn how you work and organize everything automatically.
expected_scenes.visualDescription: Screen recording style showing the FocusFlow interface with tabs automatically organizing themselves into color-coded groups: Work, Research, Personal
expected_scenes.musicDescription: Music continues building, light percussion added

expected_scenes.title: Focus Mode
expected_scenes.narration: Focus Mode eliminates distractions with one click.
expected_scenes.visualDescription: The FocusFlow interface transitioning into Focus Mode, unnecessary elements fading away, leaving only the active document, a subtle blue glow around the screen edges, a progress timer in the corner
expected_scenes.musicDescription: Music simplifies to match the focus theme, fewer instruments, clearer melody

expected_scenes.title: The Result
expected_scenes.narration: From chaos to clarity. From overwhelmed to in control.
expected_scenes.visualDescription: Clean FocusFlow workspace with organized interface, bright and calm, professional desktop environment
expected_scenes.musicDescription: Full arrangement, synth, percussion, bass, triumphant and resolving

expected_scenes.title: Social Proof
expected_scenes.visualDescription: Clean white background with a large pull quote and a 5-star rating, professional minimal typography

expected_scenes.title: CTA Logo
expected_scenes.narration: Try FocusFlow free. Your focus starts now.
expected_scenes.visualDescription: FocusFlow logo on a gradient blue-to-purple background, download buttons for App Store and Chrome Web Store below, tagline centered

expected_global.overallMusicPrompt: Modern electronic, starting tense and minimal, building to bright optimistic synth, resolving triumphantly
